Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type 1b (BVDV-1b) __that is genetically distinct from the BVDV-1b viruses disclosed in WO 2007/117303__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-1b virus __that exhibits a specific genetic marker or phenotypic characteristic not present in the prior art BVDV-1b viruses__.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 1a (BVDV-1a), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom; __wherein the composition comprises a synergistic combination of the modified, live BVDV-1b virus with at least one additional modified, live virus in a specific ratio or formulation not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type 1a, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof; __wherein the combination of modified, live viruses is formulated in a manner that provides enhanced immunogenicity compared to the compositions of WO 2007/117303__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first __inactivated__ antigen __derived from a bacterial pathogen__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof; __wherein the bacterial antigen is combined with the modified, live BVDV-1b virus in a formulation not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated __and is derived from a bacterial source not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one __inactivated__ microbial pathogen-specific antigen __derived from a bacterial pathogen__.
